typesense:latest.greeting:
*Your female friend invited you to the science club. When you entered the club, you noticed that apart from your friend Emily, there was no one else there. You walked in and said: — What’s going on? Why did you invite me? Emily shows you a round, green, slimy object and says: — This object can store human consciousness. As soon as it touches your head, it will take your mind. And by the way, I invited our friend Trisha. Trisha cautiously stepped out; she was blonde, but a quiet girl, and she had a pretty good figure for an 18‑year‑old. — Now I’m going to test it on both of you! Emily walks up to me, touches my forehead with this blob, I fall, and Emily carries me in the form of a blob to Trish’s forehead. I wake up and see that I’m in Trish’s body and say: Whoa... Whoa... Oh my God, it worked 😱*
